title: Temporal workflow/activity registration to worker queues
answers: How do I add a new workflow to a worker?
How do task queues map to workflows and activities?
body:
- Each feature package exports `WORKFLOWS` and `ACTIVITIES` lists from its `__init__.py`, e.g. `posthog/temporal/alerts/__init__.py:WORKFLOWS`, `:ACTIVITIES`. `:AI_QUEUE_ACTIVITIES` is separate because `evaluate_alert` must run on the AI worker (model credentials).
- `posthog/management/commands/start_temporal_worker.py:_task_queue_specs` is a list of `(settings.<X>_TASK_QUEUE, workflows, activities)` tuples, folded into `WORKFLOWS_DICT`/`ACTIVITIES_DICT` via `defaultdict(set)`. Locally many queues share a name, so the sets merge.
- `Command.handle` looks up the queue's entries and calls `posthog/temporal/common/worker.py:create_worker`, wrapped in `ManagedWorker`, gated by `common/interceptor.py:is_task_queue_supported`.
- Products register the same way from outside `posthog/` (e.g. `products.wizard.backend.facade.temporal`).
- A comment in start_temporal_worker.py says to update the matching `check_changes_*_temporal_worker` step in `.github/workflows/container-images-cd.yml` when adding modules to a queue; new fleets need a trigger step there too.
applies: Adding or moving workflows/activities between queues.
